name: Value increment
about: The issue of one value increment, listing its tickets
title: V<n> — <increment name>
---

Tickets of value increment V`<n>`, grouped by unit. Each ticket is a sub-issue of this issue, and this issue is a sub-issue of the roadmap ticket [#118](https://github.com/ppat/mediated-mailbox-mcp/issues/118), which lists the value increments and production points. This issue is not itself a ticket.

Each ticket's **State** is one of: **pending**, which can start any time because every ticket it is blocked by is built; **blocked**, which waits on a ticket not yet built; **in-progress**, being worked; **hold**, held by the operator and not started until the operator lifts the hold; **built**, merged to `main`.

[V`<n>` in ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/ppat/mediated-mailbox-mcp/blob/main/ROADMAP.md#INCREMENT-SECTION-ANCHOR)
